Summarise a quantified result for reporting

summarize_report.Rd

Summarise a quantified result for reporting

Usage

summarize_report(quantified, include_solvents = FALSE)

Arguments

quantified

A moosaic_result after quantify().

include_solvents

Include solvent peaks in the family and element totals.

Value

quantified with a summary list:

  • families: tibble(compound_type, wt_pct) over the eight families;

  • elements: tibble(element, wt_pct) for C, H, N, O, S, normalised to 100 (zeros when nothing was quantified);

  • totals: list(gc_recovery, methanol, water, total, element_sum);

  • qc: list(aligned_peaks (library-identified), unique_peaks (estimated), total_peaks, interpolated_peaks, ms_fid_offset (min, NA if unknown));

  • info, include_solvents.

Details

GC recovery sums wt_pct over peaks other than solvents and the names from .recovery_excluded() (methanol too when the sample has added methanol, which is reported separately).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarize_report(quantify(identified, sample_info("S1")))
} # }
